title: Broker
description: A single data-broker opt-out entry. Authored as YAML frontmatter on a per-broker markdown file under data/brokers/; compiled by scripts/build_brokers.py into data/brokers.json.

id.description: Slug matching the filename (domain with dots replaced by hyphens), e.g. spokeo-com.

domain.description: Lowercase primary hostname. Used as the merge key against legacy data and link-status.json.

people_search.description: True if this broker resells identity/address/phone lookups (highest personal-safety impact).

tier.description: Authored support-level classification: auto = email/mailto-composable, assisted = deep-link form + copy-per-field helper, guided = link + human instructions (CAPTCHA/ID/phone-gated). Not derived -- an editorial judgment call. method:email implies tier:auto; method:mail or method:phone implies tier:guided; method:form may be either assisted or guided depending on CAPTCHA/ID gating.

priority.description: Impact ranking, independent of tier. BADBOOL emoji mapping: crucial (previously priority-marked), high (previously high-priority-marked); default standard.

method.description: The mechanical channel used to opt out. Distinct from tier (tier is UX support level, method is the mechanism).

opt_out_url.description: The opt-out page URL. An angle-bracket placeholder (<verify: ...>) marks an unconfirmed value -- schema-valid but must render an unverified badge, and last_verified must be null whenever this field is a placeholder. NEVER include user PII in this URL's query string (no email=, ssn=, name=, dob=, address= params, ever) -- enforced by scripts/broker_lib.py at build time, not just by this schema.

opt_out_email.description: The address to send a CCPA-style opt-out/deletion request to. Required (non-null, non-placeholder) whenever tier is auto.

id_required.description: BADBOOL: broker demands a government ID / driver's license to process the request.

phone_required.description: BADBOOL: broker demands a phone call, not just a phone number.

charges_fee.description: BADBOOL: broker charges money for opt-out/removal.

verification.description: How the broker confirms the requester's identity/request, e.g. email_confirm, id_upload, notarized, none.

required_fields.description: Fields the broker's process requires. Presence of ssn, gov_id, or vin triggers the frontend's sensitive-data guardrail before the user proceeds.

readd_days.description: Typical re-add/re-scrape cadence in days. Null if unknown. Drives the frontend's re-check nudge.

legal_basis.description: Statutory bases this opt-out relies on, used to select the right request template.

link_status.description: NOT authored in frontmatter -- merged in at build time from data/link-status.json by URL. Present here only to document the compiled-output shape.

last_verified.description: ISO 8601 date a human last confirmed this entry's routing against the broker's own page. Must be present (even as explicit null) on every entry -- a MISSING key fails the build; an explicit null means unconfirmed and the frontend must render an unverified badge. Must be null whenever opt_out_url or opt_out_email is a <verify: ...> placeholder.

source.description: Provenance tag, e.g. dbw, badbool, tcp-research, dbw+tcp-research. Distinguishes TCP-authored content (research_note, tier/priority judgments, instructions_md) from re-derived upstream facts, for licensing/attribution purposes.

notes.description: Short authoring note, distinct from the markdown body (instructions_md).
